successors.name: Kingdom of the Franks
successors.text: Westphalia, Angria and Eastphalia, Frankish since 785 and 794 and organised as the Carolingian Duchy of Saxony (804-1296) after 'the emperor Charlemagne conquered the Saxons' in 804

successors.name: Obotrites
successors.text: the part of the Saxons' former land in Holstein north of the Elbe, 'awarded to the Obotrites in 804, as a reward for their victory' (the Obotrites page adds 'This however was soon reverted through an…

ledger.x: 283: the Saxons live at the mouth of the Elbe.
449: Saxons cross to Britain.
455: Old Saxony fills the land between the Elbe and the Rhine.
555: Chlothar I attacks the Saxons.
556: the Saxons and Franks make peace.
772: Charlemagne invades Saxony.
775: Charlemagne takes Saxony but for Nordalbingia.
775: the first campaign ends in Frankish control of all but Nordalbingia.
778: the Saxons rise while Charlemagne is in Spain.
779: Charlemagne reconquers Saxony.
782: Widukind's revolt.
782: the rebels hold the Saxon provinces.
785: Widukind submits.
785: Saxony passes to the Franks.
793: the Saxons rise again.
793: the rebels hold Old Saxony.
794: the revolt is 'completely put down by 794'.

794: Westphalia, Angria and Eastphalia pass to the Franks again; an Engrian rebellion in 796 was crushed 'quickly with Charlemagne's personal presence' and the death penalty for paganism was abolished in 797.
798: the Obotrites beat the Nordalbingians at Bornhöved.
804: Charlemagne gives Holstein to the Obotrites.
804: the Saxon Wars end.

wars.name: Chlothar I's Saxon wars
wars.outcome: Chlothar conquered the revolted Saxons in 555, they revolted again, and after a bloody battle the two made peace on a tribute of 500 cows a year.

wars.name: Frankish campaigns of Charles Martel against the Saxons
wars.outcome: No frontier moved: 718 he laid waste their country to the Weser, Lippe and Ruhr, 731 he defeated them, and in 738 he 'compelled the Saxons of Westphalia to submit and pay tribute'.

wars.name: Frankish campaigns of Carloman and Pepin against the Saxons
wars.outcome: Carloman invaded Saxony in 743 and the brothers again in 744; Pepin marched in 748 and 753 and in 758 accepted a tribute of 330 horses a year; no frontier moved.

wars.name: Saxon Wars
wars.outcome: Charlemagne's thirty years of war: Eresburg and the Irminsul (772); Frankish control of all but Nordalbingia (775); the Saxon rising to Deutz (778); reconquest (779); Widukind's revolt, Süntel and Verden (782); Widukind's baptism (785); the revolt of 792-794…

wars.name: Battle of Bornhöved (798)
wars.outcome: Thrasco's Obotrites, allied with the Franks, defeated the Nordalbingian Saxons; the land north of the Elbe went to the Obotrites in 804.

certainty.note: The Saxon frontiers are rivers and forest (Ems, Weser, Elbe, Harz, Hesse) known only from Frankish campaigns and the later duchy; nothing is surveyed.
